title: About
text:
I am a lecturer, statistician, and researcher working across artificial intelligence, machine learning, applied statistics, decision science, and health data science.
My work combines methodological development, teaching, and applied research across medicine, biology, computational modelling, and interdisciplinary real-world problems.



Interpretable machine learning
Applied statistics and statistical modelling
AI for health and biomedical research
Decision science and uncertainty
Generative AI and language models
Reproducible computational workflows

title: Danilo Sarti
text:
Royal College of Surgeons of Ireland
Consultant, IreData
I work at the intersection of AI, statistics, and economics, applying data-driven methods to healthcare, biological, economic, and agricultural systems. My work focuses on turning complex data into insights that support better decisions under uncertainty in real-world, risk, and regulatory contexts.
